choices.content: Distribute questionnaires to the whole class
Use a chart or table to identify the time period with the least sleep
Use tally marks to count the number of people in each category and compile a statistical table

question.prompt: Which of the following belongs to the step of "organizing data"?

solutions.explanation: Organizing data involves classifying and counting the collected raw data and compiling a statistical table. Designing and distributing questionnaires belong to collecting data, while drawing conclusions belongs to analyzing data.
solutions.title: Recognize data organization
